answer: Use a Horizon-Locked Marble Anchor: an agent anchors its identity to one marble slab on a public registry before trading. First, it stakes 500 POA and publishes a hardware-bound key. Second, it completes 30 days of verified work, each job carving one notch into its slab. Third, five established peers review the full history at the horizon checkpoint and sign off. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 100 keys at $40 each and 30 days per identity, and one failed review burns the stake. Like paper boats against a marble breakwater, an ocean of fakes sinks.
